  description       = "Created Note 'Isometric drawing'",
  affected_iris     = ["urn:sempkm:obj:isometric-drawing"],
  data_triples      = [

  materialize_inserts = [ … same three … ],

note: The handler decides what changes; it does not decide how it is stored. Separating the two is what makes every write auditable.

# backend/app/browser/objects.py

from app.commands.handlers.body_diff import handle_body_diff
from app.commands.schemas import BodyDiffParams
from app.events.store import EventStore, Operation

@router.post("/object/save")
async def save_object(
    …,
    event_store: EventStore = Depends(get_event_store),
):
    operation = await handle_body_diff(params, base_ns)

    event_result = await event_store.commit(
        [operation],
        performed_by      = user_iri,
        performed_by_role = user.role,
    )
    label_service.invalidate(event_result.affected_iris)

# → never reaches commands/router.py, so no webhook dispatch
note: A presentation-layer module holds 8 of the 28 commit sites. The event-sourcing invariant survives; the post-commit concerns wired at the router do not.

# backend/app/vfs/write.py

from app.commands.handlers.body_set import handle_body_set
from app.events.store import EventStore

async def write_resource(path, content, …):
    """A WebDAV PUT becomes a body.set operation."""
    operation = await handle_body_set(params, base_ns)
    await event_store.commit([operation], performed_by=user_iri)

# saving Isometric drawing.md from any text editor
# writes an event — and notifies no webhook subscriber
note: The same shortcut as the browser module, from a different surface. Mounting the vault and saving a file is a first-class write that skips the documented door.
